auth.activateIntro: Enter your membership card number and the email you gave the club, then choose a password.
auth.activateSuccess: Account activated. You can now log in.
auth.alreadyActive: Already have an account? Log in

errors.ACTIVATION_FAILED: We couldn't activate the account with these details. Check the card number and email, or ask the club to reset your access.
errors.WEAK_PASSWORD: The password must be at least 8 characters long.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.

booking.NOT_ON_STEP: The start time must be a multiple of 15 minutes.
booking.BEFORE_OPENING: The club opens at 08:00: pick a later time.
booking.AFTER_CLOSING: The booking must end by closing time (23:00).
booking.BAD_DURATION: The duration must be 1 or 2 consecutive slots.
booking.IN_PAST: You can't book a time that has already passed.
booking.TOO_FAR_AHEAD: You can book at most 14 days ahead.
booking.MEMBERSHIP_EXPIRED: Your membership isn't valid for that day: it has expired or is missing.
booking.MAX_ACTIVE_REACHED: You already have the maximum number of active bookings.
booking.BLOCKED: Your account is blocked because of unpaid bookings. Please contact the club.
booking.OVERLAP: That field is already booked at that time.
booking.ALREADY_CANCELLED: This booking has already been cancelled.
booking.WINDOW_CLOSED: Less than 2 hours to the start: it can no longer be changed or cancelled.
booking.FIELD_INACTIVE: This field can't be booked at the moment.
